benchmark_verifier.execution: Standalone task verifier on thu-sui with licensed Spectre; no complete Harbor container/agent run.

calibration_history.analysis_repair: First r1 analysis incorrectly expected time inside each EVAS solution; repaired to use transient.times. Original analysis retained, not a DUT failure. Stop-setting audit uses exact PSF endpoint because log display rounds it.
calibration_history.r1: Reference 6/8 on Spectre: descending and ramp at reltol=1e-10 exceeded event-time allowance; external limits unchanged.
calibration_history.r2: Reference profiles reltol=1e-11 and 1e-12; 8/8 on both backends. Equivalent models 2/2; four deliberate mutants all rejected by Spectre verifier logic.
